speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have they spread to your feet?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Dirofilaria immitis (Heartworm) with potential cutaneous larva migrans or angiostrongyliasis, given the rice farming and livestock exposure, pruritic rash, and neuropathy. REQUEST TEST: Serology for Dirofilaria, Angiostrongylus, and Echinococcus; Skin Biopsy. REQUEST IMAGES: Dermoscopy of rash and MRI of hands.
